blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Manufacturing & Industrial level this capability reads as: solver tournament on job-shop/changeover formulations (makespan improvements where hybrid solvers win). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

The weekly rhythm below is identical across programs of this type. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
